## Interfaces

### Config

```ts
interface Config {
    /** The folder the config file is in: every path in it is relative to this. */
    readonly root: string;
    readonly file: string;
    readonly input?: string;
    readonly overlays: readonly string[];
    readonly plugins: readonly string[];
    readonly targets: Readonly<Record<string, Target>>;
    readonly extract: ExtractConfig;
    /** Absent when the config has no `diff` section. */
    readonly diff?: DiffConfig;
    /** `contractdiff lint`'s rulesets and per-rule levels; absent when the config has no `lint` section. */
    readonly lint?: LintConfig;
}
```

### ContractMap

```ts
interface ContractMap {
    readonly version: 1;
    readonly operations: Readonly<Record<string, readonly MapEntry[]>>;
    readonly files: Readonly<Record<string, MapFile>>;
}
```

### ExtractOptions

```ts
interface ExtractOptions {
    readonly cwd: string;
    readonly config?: string | undefined;
    /** The extractor's name; the config's `extract.from` when absent. */
    readonly from?: string | undefined;
    /** The spec file to write; the config's `extract.out`, else `spec.json`. */
    readonly out?: string | undefined;
    readonly check?: boolean | undefined;
    readonly dryRun?: boolean | undefined;
    readonly force?: boolean | undefined;
}
```

### FileReport

```ts
interface FileReport {
    readonly path: string;
    readonly owner: Owner;
    readonly action: Action;
    /** The target that produced it; absent for the map itself. */
    readonly target?: string;
}
```

### GenOptions

```ts
interface GenOptions {
    /** Where a config is looked for, and what `--config` is relative to. */
    readonly cwd: string;
    readonly config?: string | undefined;
    /** Run only these targets; every target when absent or empty. */
    readonly targets?: readonly string[] | undefined;
    readonly check?: boolean | undefined;
    readonly dryRun?: boolean | undefined;
    readonly force?: boolean | undefined;
}
```

### MapEntry

```ts
interface MapEntry {
    readonly file: string;
    readonly symbol: string;
    readonly target: string;
    /**
     * `user` for the symbol the user owns that implements the operation (R-BL1): a method of the
     * controller class or a member of the handlers object a target wrote once. Absent for a generated one.
     */
    readonly owner?: 'user';
}
```

### Report

```ts
interface Report {
    readonly files: readonly FileReport[];
    /** Whether a file was written or deleted, or would be under `--check` and `--dry-run`: what burgee asks of an idempotent command (N7). */
    readonly changed: boolean;
    /** How many files were written or deleted, or would be. */
    readonly changes: number;
    readonly unchanged: number;
    /** User files left as they are. */
    readonly skipped: number;
    readonly findings: readonly (ContractFinding & {
        readonly target: string;
    })[];
    /** `--dry-run`: the unified diff of every change. */
    readonly diff?: string;
    /** `--check`: the files that are not what a run would write. */
    readonly stale?: readonly string[];
    readonly exitCode?: 1;
    readonly fix?: string;
}
```

### Target

```ts
interface Target {
    /** The generator's name, as a plugin registers it. */
    readonly generator: string;
    /** The output folder, relative to the project root, with `/` separators. */
    readonly out: string;
    readonly options: Options;
}
```
